chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from an-Nadr ibn Suwayd from al-Qasim ibn Sulayman from Jarrah al-Mad'ani who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever sees the crescent of Shawwal - during the day in Ramadan - let him complete his fasting.'

key_terms.هِلَالُ شَوَّالٍ: Crescent of the month of Shawwal

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if the Shawwal crescent is seen during the day in Ramadan?
ai.summary: This ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the continuity of Ramadan when the Shawwal crescent is sighted during daylight hours, ensuring the day is not prematurely ended. It highlights the Shia emphasis on the actual sighting of the moon as the definitive marker for ending the fast, distinguishing it from mere calculation. This hadith is found in Chapter 41 of *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, which deals with the signs of the beginning and end of Ramadan.
